description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open source project and handles the display and management of event logs, including filtering, deleting, and rendering event data in a table format.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class for rendering extended tables with features like grouping, sorting, and toolbar controls.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine wrapper used for rendering the final output.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns the arguments object for the page, parsing POST and REQUEST parameters.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has rights to view or clear event logs.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object with user info, log levels, and permissions.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Generates filter criteria based on user input for date range and testers.

methods.name: buildExtTable
methods.description: Builds and returns an extended table of events for display, including sorting and grouping.
